semanticsText: Two players on an 8x8 board select three distinct ordered professions from five. Joining only occupies a seat; the creator starts Squad Commit manually. Validate both squads against the same round-start state and reserve total skill costs before income. Full orthogonal paths cannot revisit cells or cross obstacles or other living origins; cancel all shared endpoints and allow empty intermediate crossings. Heal living friendly identities including self at post-movement Manhattan distance up to two, before damage; cap HP and discard excess without resurrection. Reduce every damage source by Cover before summing and applying Guardian shield; apply damage simultaneously including dying attackers. A legal Saboteur hit locks a surviving target in the next round only, including when its caster dies; preserve the current skill, clear death locks and expire old locks without stacks. Legal dynamic misses retain costs. Clear deaths before resource income and central majority scoring. Elimination precedes VP threshold and round limit; compare VP then surviving HP then draw. Commitments are immutable; accept submissions at the deadline and finalize defaults strictly after it. Single defaults forfeit and bilateral defaults draw without battle processing. Preserve original deployments and historical meanings.

lifecycle.join: WAITING remains WAITING; a different address occupies the second seat
lifecycle.start: creator-only, full unexpired room; opens SQUAD_COMMIT with activeRound=0
lifecycle.cancel: creator-only while WAITING, including after the join deadline until expiry executes
lifecycle.expire: public while WAITING, strictly after joinDeadline
lifecycle.squadReveal: second valid reveal initializes the board and opens ROUND_COMMIT with activeRound=1 and completedRound=0
lifecycle.roundReveal: second valid reveal opens RESOLVABLE with deadline zero
lifecycle.settle: public once in RESOLVABLE; retain completedRound=n and open activeRound=n+1 or finish
lifecycle.default: public in either Squad or Round Commit/Reveal strictly after its deadline; expected phase and activeRound must still match
lifecycle.replacement: accepted commitments cannot change; an originally illegal payload cannot be rescued with a different lineup or order

canonical.pathOrder: cell i occupies bits 6*i through 6*i+5, first visited cell in the least significant six bits
canonical.pathBits: only pathLength*6 low bits may be nonzero; all other bits must be zero
canonical.deadUnit: retain type and slot; position=255 hp=0 alive=false lockedRound=0; action=HOLD
canonical.liveLock: zero, or completedRound+1 after at least one settled round; initial locks are zero
canonical.rounds: activeRound belongs to protocol; completedRound belongs to the hashed battle state; both are uint16
canonical.pregame: battleStarted=false, completedRound=0, six empty slots (type=0 position=255 hp=0 alive=false lock=0), zero Energy and VP; Squad defaults set only outcome/reason
canonical.timeout: preserve board, resources and completedRound; set dedicated outcome/reason; emit MatchFinished without RoundResolved
canonical.implementationBinding: rulesetId binds typed parameters, the reviewed semantic definition, schema IDs and the fixed map catalogue; the separate deployment and existing archived compiler artifacts bind the actual implementation

secrets.randomness: independent cryptographically secure Squad and Action salts
secrets.unrevealedDestinations: browser IndexedDB and user-controlled encrypted backups only; never logs, API, SSE or Commit events
